integrity: The proof substitutes the exact soft-threshold proximal map into the source definitions of the forward-backward residual, three-term Hestenes--Stiefel direction, corrected curvature vector, and two-stage line search. Every inequality is checked symbolically, and a standalone exact-rational script replays representative source-compatible instances.
scientific_limitations: The exact recurrence is a one-dimensional convex composite benchmark with zero smooth term. It characterizes exact-stationarity identification of the iterate path; practical positive stopping tolerances terminate once the residual is sufficiently small. Higher-dimensional partial-smoothness identification and the weakly convex extension are not classified.
title: Exact soft-threshold bypass and geometric non-identification in proximal nonlinear conjugate gradient
